ops.title: Replace live card JSON persistence with keyed SQLite
ops.description: Owner: live-card-sqlite-nov13 implementation lane; next: implement keyed SQLite and import, leave uncommitted receipt for root review, hosted CI, rollout and affected-case measurement. Evidence: livecards.go save serializes and rewrites all card/ref state on every actual mutation. Local build/test/benchmark/install and process operations forbidden.

ops.text: Keyed atomic SQLite mutations, ref-only persistence, retained card semantics and one-time crash-safe JSON cutover implemented
Root reviews changes and hosted CI passes restart, no-op, keyed mutation, pruning and import tests
Root ships, installs and verifies the affected operation after installation
